By virtue of the authority vested in me as President of the United States of
America, and pursuant to the provisions of Section 9 of the Act of Congress approved
on June 7, 1924, entitled, "An Act To provide for the protection of forest lands, for
the reforestation of denuded areas, for the extension of national forests, and for
other purposes, in order to promote the continuous production of timber on lands
chiefly suitable therefor," the following described lands which comprise a part of
the Fort Eustis Military Reservation in the State of Virginia, and which, in the
opinion of the Secretary of War and the Secretary of Agriculture, are suitable for
the production of timber, hereby are established as a National Forest, to wit:
All of that part of the Fort Eustis Military Reservation as shown upon the map
hereto attached and made a part hereof.
The National Forest hereby created shall be known as the Eustis National
Forest.
The said Eustis National Forest shall be administered by the Secretary of
Agriculture under such rules and regulations and in accordance with such general
plans as may be jointly approved by the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary
of War, for the use, occupation and protection of such lands and for the sale of
products therefrom.

the unhampered use of the War Department for purposes of national defense and

It is hereby ordered that the following described tract of land in the State of
California, be, and it is hereby temporarily withdrawn from settlement, entry,
sale, or other disposition until March 5, 1927, for the use and benefit of the Indians
of the Mesa Grande Indian Reservation, under the jurisdiction of the Mission
Indian Agency in California, viz:
W/2 of the SW/4 of Sec. 11,
T. 12S.,R. 2E. of S.B. M.
i Cafo naco tiig8 ace.If legislation is not enacted prior to M arch 5, 1927, to withdraw this land per-
manently, and if no other direction is given regarding the disposition thereof, the
land will on that date, become subject to disposal under any law then applicable
thereto without further order. Provided that this temporary withdrawal shall not
affect any existing legal right of any person to any of the land described herein.
* CALVIN COOLIDGE
THE WHITE HOUSE,
August 27, 1925.
